chunks: He said: The yellowness two days before the menstruation is from the menstruation; and after the days of menstruation it is not from the menstruation; and it during the days of menstruation is menstruation.

key_terms.الحيض: Haydh — menstruation; a state of ritual impurity during which prayer and fasting are suspended
key_terms.الصفرة: Sufra — yellowish vaginal discharge; treated differently depending on its timing relative to menstruation

ai.seo_question: Is yellowish discharge (sufra) before or after menstruation considered part of haydh in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith provides a jurisprudential ruling from the Imam regarding yellowish vaginal discharge (sufra) in relation to the menstrual period. The ruling distinguishes three scenarios: discharge appearing two days before menstruation counts as part of it; discharge after the menstrual days does not count; and discharge occurring during the established menstrual days is treated as menstrual blood. This ruling is significant for determining the ritual purity status of women and their obligations regarding prayer and fasting.
